bluf: Reuters and France 24 reported US strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island. In southern Ukraine, France 24 reported 29 killed and 48 missing after a Russian attack on a site where people had gathered for humanitarian aid; France 24 also reported cyberattacks on emergency alert systems in Russia and Ukraine that broadcast fake nuclear warnings.

items.text: France 24 reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on a humanitarian aid site in southern Ukraine rose to 29, with 48 still missing.

France 24 reported that cyberattacks overnight hit emergency alert systems in Russia and Ukraine, broadcasting fake warnings of possible nuclear strikes; the systems were brought back under control, though much about the attacks remained unclear.
Reuters and France 24 reported US strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island.
